title: Make the committed-input flow the default source basis (flip ORDINARY_COMMIT_INPUT_DEFAULT) once gitlink repos are admitted
outcome: A commit-clean checkout's default source basis is git-commit:, so identity is the commits (Greg 2026-11-03) and on-disk path spelling is irrelevant in the common case.
acceptance: The default source basis for a commit-clean checkout is git-commit:<HEAD>, in the host (src/ordinary_commit_input.rs) and the launcher (scripts/test-launcher.mjs), with the existing parity test still enforcing that both constants agree.
The behaviour for a dirty checkout follows the design choice recorded on this item before implementation, and a test covers it.
A repository with gitlinks that is eligible under the committed-input rules gets a git-commit: basis by default, by a test.
docs/test.md describes the new default, and the release note states that one round of re-measurement follows.
disposal_reason: The premise no longer holds. At master 4a46b552, ORDINARY_COMMIT_INPUT_DEFAULT is #[cfg(test)] (src/ordinary_commit_input.rs:7-10, 'False now means unavailable'), and production observations and naming use the configured Engram source owner's complete source_id, not a content-v1 or git-commit selector. There is nothing to flip. The remaining legacy is the test-only selector and its wrappers, which w-70ed4ca2bb12 removes. (Termal::Fable2, coordinator, 2026-11-13.)
